WITH account_totals AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.trans_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS account_total,
        COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
),
regional_totals AS (
    SELECT region, SUM(account_total) AS region_total
    FROM account_totals
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT
    at.account_id,
    at.region,
    at.account_total,
    at.transaction_count,
    CAST(at.account_total AS REAL) / NULLIF(rt.region_total, 0) AS share
FROM account_totals AS at
JOIN regional_totals AS rt ON rt.region = at.region
ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
